title: Chapter 164: Explosive Mosquitoes Turn The Tide Of Battle
content:
Chapter 164: Explosive Mosquitoes Turn The Tide Of Battle

The Naga warriors and Zerg puppies continued to march, and soon they could see the battlefield ahead from the ground.

Nagalong was an experienced battlefield commander. When approaching the battlefield, he slowed down his march and sent Naga warriors to clear the enemy scouts around the battlefield.

He ordered the reinforcements to stop outside the visible range of the battlefield and personally led people to observe the battlefield situation. Host No. 3 was flying in the air and was also very large, so he did not call Host No. 3 to join him.

After a while, Nagalong returned from the front with a somewhat ugly face. He came to Host No. 3.

"Leader No. 3, this time the evil god camp dispatched the main force of the bear goblin tribe!"

"They have a very powerful evil god priest team to command the battle. The main force of our tribe can't make it. Even if the noble reinforcements participate in this battle, the chances of winning are not great!"

"I can send someone to lead the way and take you to join the main force of our tribe. Both sides will concentrate their strength and strive to destroy this evil god army in one battle!"

Google search TWKAN

After Nagalong finished speaking, he summoned a Naga warrior and wanted to order him to lead the Zerg army.

"Are you going to play in person?"

Wu Qing has already possessed host No. 3, and he has been paying attention to the situation here.

"I am leading the elite troops of my tribe. I will personally command them to fight so that I can act according to the situation and buy some time for the main force!"

"Leader No. 3, please rest assured that I will not act rashly!"

Nagalong replied. He is not an ordinary person who is emotional, but a qualified battlefield commander who will not go to die regardless of the overall situation.

"Perhaps we don't need to wait for the main force of the nobles. We can try to directly destroy the sacrificial team of the evil god army!"

"The army of the evil god camp will lose the faith blessing and command of the priests, and its combat power will be greatly reduced!"

"With our current forces, we should be able to end this war before the main force of the nobles arrives!"

Wu Qing said to Nagalong through Host No. 3.

Nagalong was overjoyed when he heard this, and hurriedly asked: "Is there any way to destroy the sacrificial team under the layers of protection of the evil god army?"

"You can try the explosive mosquitoes, the flying soldiers that our tribe has recently supported!"

After Wu Qing saw the situation on the battlefield clearly, he wanted to try the explosive mosquitoes on the battlefield. With their abilities, see if they can directly kill the most important sacrificial team in the evil god army.

Nagalong has always been curious about the 1,000 accompanying explosive mosquitoes. This kind of flying soldier is not as big as the Zerg puppy, and he can't see what they rely on to fight.

The Zerg did not take the initiative to introduce it, and he couldn't ask.

The Zerg will now reveal their true colors. Since they have chosen to use them to destroy the most heavily guarded evil god sacrificial team, their combat power must be strong.

"Okay! If there is a possibility of success, please give it a try!"

Nagalong agreed very straightforwardly without saying much thanks.

Wu Qing asked the Queen to calculate the power of the explosive mosquitoes and estimated the defensive capabilities of the evil god sacrificial team. He was ready to send 200 explosive mosquitoes to test it in actual combat.

The 200 explosive mosquitoes received the order and left the group above the Zerg puppies, flying higher and higher, and instantly became a small black dot.

The explosive mosquitoes approached the sacrificial group in the center of the evil god camp through the high altitude. The changes in the high altitude did not attract the attention of anyone except Nagalong and the Naga warriors who had been paying attention.

The 200 explosive mosquitoes came to the high altitude directly above the location of the evil god sacrificial group, and began to dive at high speed, rushing towards the evil god sacrificial group.

The unknown danger immediately alerted the evil god's chief priest, but he seemed not to have discovered that the danger came from high altitude.

The attack of the explosive mosquitoes was sensed by the enemy, and they instantly entered the burst acceleration mode, and the speed of diving was more than twice as fast!

The small body of the explosive mosquitoes in the air, like a lightning bolt!

When the evil god priest team and the guard force below them finally realized that the danger came from the air, it was too late!

One by one, the small dots smashed into the center of the evil god priest group at a very high speed, and violent explosions occurred around the evil god priests who looked incredulous!

"Boom!

!"

"Boom!

!"

"Boom! Boom!"

It started with the most concentrated and violent explosion. Wu Qing did not skimp. The first time, 100 explosive mosquitoes smashed into the evil god priest group at once, triggering a terrible chain explosion!

The spiritual power of the queen of insects descended on host No. 3 to personally observe the killing effect of the explosive mosquitoes.

100 explosive mosquitoes exploded at the same time, with amazing power. Except for the evil god priest who was protected by the evil god's power, all the others were blown into white light and disappeared!

In the game setting, ordinary soldiers can be killed by one or two explosive mosquitoes. Even the battleships of the human race and the motherships of the Protoss can be blown up with only five or six explosive mosquitoes, which shows its strong lethality!

In this real world, the Zerg's soldiers were weakened by the system in order to adapt to the rules of this world, but their relative lethality has not weakened.

100 explosive mosquitoes, that is, 3750 gas resources, smashed down at once, for others except the evil god priest, it was a bit too much, and the evil god priest team and the evil god army in a large area around were all blown up.

The queen recorded these data in detail as a reference for future explosive mosquito attacks.

The following two explosions were supplementary attacks on the High Priest who was protected by the power of the evil god.

The second explosion was a self-explosion attack by 10 explosive mosquitoes, but it still failed to break the protective power of the evil god!

The third explosion was a self-explosion attack by 20 explosive mosquitoes, which finally successfully consumed the power of the evil god and blew the High Priest into white light!

130 explosive mosquitoes exploded, consuming 4875 gas resources, and successfully eliminated the priest team including the High Priest of the Evil God who was protected by the power of the evil god, including the elite guards around them.

Wu Qing calculated that this price was very worthwhile, which was equivalent to sacrificing less than 200 hydralisks and successfully turning the situation of this war around!

Moreover, this explosion directly caused the gas resources of the system to soar!

"This explosive mosquito is used in key places, which is still very cost-effective!"

After such actual combat tests, Wu Qing had a clear understanding of the positioning of the explosive mosquito in the Zerg. If used well, it is enough to change the situation!

After the explosion of the explosive mosquito, the army of the evil god camp instantly lost its backbone. Not only did it lose the blessing of combat power, but it also lost unified command. The 300,000 main forces and a large number of logistical personnel and supplies became headless flies!

Everyone on the battlefield felt the change in the position of the central army of the evil god camp. The lower-level officers of the evil god camp army could only continue to command the battle according to the previous orders. Without new orders, they were at a loss!

Their firm belief made them fight to the death, and their fanatical belief made them not care about anything other than the belief in gods. The complete destruction of the evil god sacrificial team did not affect the fanaticism of the front-line combat soldiers.

But the gradually disappearing blessing of faith made their combat power continue to decline, and the loss of effective command made them inflexible and fight on their own.

The Naga army on the battlefield found that a terrible explosion had occurred in the central army position of the evil god camp army, which seemed to be attacked from the air. Their morale was suddenly boosted. The battle that was originally bound to die now saw some hope.

...

"Great!"

Nagalong and the Naga warriors couldn't help cheering.

They witnessed the horrific attack of the Zerg Explosive Swarm from beginning to end, and were shocked by the attack method and attack power of the Explosive Swarm's self-explosion!

"Prepare to attack!"

"Fight, fight, fight!"

There was no time to think, now was the best time to attack!

Nagalong did not ask the Zerg to fight, and led the Naga warriors to rush out alone.

"Attack!"

Wu Qing issued an attack order through Host No. 3.

The enemies on the battlefield are all resources, and the Naga tribe cannot be snatched away.

Two hundred thousand Zerg puppies instantly accelerated their charge, and a terrible black tide rushed towards the army of the evil god camp from one side of the battlefield!

"Reinforcements! Reinforcements have arrived!"

"Kill! Kill them hard for me!"

"..."

The Naga commanders on the battlefield discovered the Naga warriors and the Zerg army at the first time, and they commanded the Naga army to press forward!

The enemy's core was completely lost and fell into chaos. We had a large number of reinforcements to flank the enemy formation. This was a great opportunity to quickly break the enemy. The Naga army launched a full-scale attack!

In the phalanx of the evil god camp, the evil god army close to the direction of the Zerg army's attack, under the command of the lower-level officers, spontaneously turned the formation to defend against the impact of the Naga warriors and Zerg puppies.

More than a thousand Naga warriors led by Nagalong showed their powerful strength!

From a distance, the high-speed continuous shooting disrupted the enemy formation in front of them. Facing the enemy's disorganized long-range attack, they put away their bows and arrows and picked up shields and swords.

The Naga warriors held their shields and crashed into the enemy formation at high speed like snakes. They hit the enemy's defense line with shields and swords, with strong strength and superb martial arts. They rushed into the formation and killed a lot!

The Zerg puppies followed closely behind. Facing the ordinary army of the bear goblin clan, they already had an absolute combat advantage.

The Zerg puppies' knife arms slashed down, and the defenses of the various races of the evil god camp were completely unable to resist. They were either severely injured or directly killed and turned into light!

The enemy's weapons could only leave some marks on the Zerg Puppy's carapace, which had been upgraded many times. Ordinary attacks could no longer break through the defense.

The increase in speed made the Zerg Puppy's attack speed and frequency faster, and its killing efficiency increased greatly.

The Zerg Puppy's charge broke through the fearless defense line of the evil god believers!

The follow-up was a continuous stream of Zerg Puppies, which kept rushing into the evil god camp army and massacred the evil god believers!

The army in the middle square of the evil god camp had not yet had time to obtain the blessing of the evil god's sacrifice. Its combat power was greatly reduced compared to the outer army, and it was no match for the Zerg Puppy.

The Zerg Puppy got rid of the Zerg Hydralisk for the first time and became the absolute core combat power on the battlefield!
